gold_note: Time-calibrated hadrosauroid tree, 77 tips, fully resolved; a long pectinate backbone with nodes a few pixels apart, resolved from per-column line runs and the drawing's rule that each node's stem joins midway between its first and last child. Tip region letters (A)-(F) and clade labels are not part of the names. Random-sample case (seed 20261106). Topology transcribed from the figure and checked node by node; topology only.
